title: The OOM Killer
story: The reporting job dies every night at 03:00 with no error of its own. Something is killing it.
goal: Find which process the kernel killed and report its name.

files./var/log/syslog:
Nov 24 02:59:50 host kernel: Memory cgroup out of memory: Killed process 8814 (report-gen) total-vm:9120044kB
Nov 24 03:00:02 host cron[221]: (oncall) CMD (/opt/nightly.sh)
Nov 24 03:10:00 host kernel: eth0: link up

hints: The kernel logs a message when it kills a process for lack of memory. What word does it use?

Run:
free -h
grep -i killed /var/log/syslog
Then answer: report-gen
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
